chapter: After the Paradise: club dates and Virginia
title: Rock and roll takes over the clubs
summary: With rock and roll the owners wanted something new and club dates were all that was left.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: But then a point was reached where you said, "things went bad," and you started regularly doing these...

Club dates. Yeah, that was all that was left because rock and roll came in and so the people went for that, you know, owners and what not, you know, "This is new; this is new." So what are you going to do? You can't fight city hall. So I went into that because you know that every week you're going to get something, you know. And the other jobs, where you stay on a job a year or two years and you go on another job and stay two years, you knew what you were doin'. Shoot.
There was a transition there when that rock and roll came in. There was a heavy transition. So I started doin' that, yeah.
